Resolve a statistical-analysis config value: nested location, then flat, then default

Source: R/statistics.R
dot-stat_cfg.Rd

get_statistical_analysis_defaults() nests every statistical parameter under config$statistical_analysis$..., but the enhanced-chain functions (analyze_property_distributions(), detect_comprehensive_outliers(), run_comprehensive_correlation_analysis()) were written reading them flat off config$... with no fallback - under the package's own documented default usage (analyze_soil_statistics(horizon_data), no analysis_config) that made config$minimum_observations NULL and hard-errored the enhanced chain. This mirrors analyze_soil_statistics()'s own config$statistical_analysis$X %||% config$X %||% <default> pattern (see its min_quality_score line). Defaults here match the _safe chain's hardcoded values and get_statistical_analysis_defaults().

Usage

.stat_cfg(config, key, default)

Arguments

config

The (merged) analysis configuration.

key

Parameter name.

default

Fallback when the key is absent in both locations.
